status: Show status of device(s): [psu1, psu2, slta, tvac, cryo]
ccvout: Cryocooler output voltage in V (12-20). e.g. --ccvout 12
ccout: Cryocooler output ON or OFF. e.g. --ccout on
ccvres: Cryocooler variable resistor in ohms. Rounded to nearest 6-bit code; status shows CCVRES#. e.g. --ccvres 270
psu2ch1: PSU2 CH1 control: on, off, set <V> <A>. e.g., --psu2ch1 set 12 1.25
psu2ch2: PSU2 CH2 control: on, off, set <V> <A>. e.g., --psu2ch2 on
exposure: Set exposure time (<sec> or 'auto' for umbra-based)
nsamp: Set number of samples per pixel (integer, 1-1000). e.g., --nsamp 4
clear: Set clear dwell time in seconds (integer, 0-600). e.g., --clear 30
sltaversion: Set SLTA driver version (v1 or v2). e.g., --sltaversion v2
IMAGEDIR: Set image subdirectory (no spaces): e.g. --IMAGEDIR blanks; use --IMAGEDIR default to reset
